Electrical Isolation & LOTO Permit 17 checkpoints across 6 sections.Before any work on or near electrical equipment above ELV; revalidated per shift Download ExcelDownload PDF **17** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per shift or per electrical work activity Authorised Electrical Person, Electrical Supervisor [IS 14489:1998](https://infralens.in/code/IS-14489-1998) [NBC 2016:2016](https://infralens.in/code/NBC-2016-Part-4-2016) Related [📐IS 14489](https://infralens.in/code/IS-14489) [✏️Parking Bay Small Car](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/parking-bay-small-car) [📘Site Safety Checklist](https://infralens.in/handbook/site-safety-checklist) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧steel-table](https://infralens.in/tools/steel-table) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. ISOLATION AND DISCONNECTION | | A1 | Source isolator / breaker identified and opened; visible break confirmed where possible
Acceptance: Correct isolator identified from SLD; racked-out or open with visible air gap | CEA Reg 41 — Isolation | OK

Acceptance: All sources listed; UPS output isolated; backfeed from bus-couplers verified off | CEA Reg 41 — Multiple sources | OK
NC

NC
NA

Acceptance: One lock per worker; key held personally; multi-hasp for team work | Cl. 7 — LOTO | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | DANGER — DO NOT OPERATE tag with name, date, time, contact attached to isolator
Acceptance: Legible tag; laminated; weather-proof; signed by person applying | Cl. 7 — Tag-out | OK

NA

Acceptance: Start attempt confirms dead; all control voltages off; logged in permit | Cl. 7 — Verification | OK
